description: This file defines a MapWidgetController class implementing map widget functionalities for a dashboard, including map initialization, settings, actions, and data updates, specifically for the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: MapWidgetController
classes.description: Main class managing map widget behavior, including initialization, settings, actions, data updates, and cleanup.

methods.name: actionSources
methods.description: Returns predefined action source configurations for marker, polygon, circle clicks, and tooltip actions.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Translates a given key using the widget's translation services.

methods.name: getDescriptors
methods.description: Retrieves action descriptors for a specified action type.

methods.name: onCustomAction
methods.description: Handles custom widget actions triggered by user interactions.

methods.name: setMarkerLocation
methods.description: Sets marker location based on event data or provided coordinates.

methods.name: savePolygonLocation
methods.description: Saves polygon location data based on event or provided coordinates.

methods.name: saveLocation
methods.description: Saves location data (attributes or timeseries) for an entity.

methods.name: initSettings
methods.description: Initializes widget settings, parsing functions and configuring map options.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates map data if map instance exists.

methods.name: latestDataUpdate
methods.description: Refreshes map data with latest information.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up and removes map instance.
